At the same time, an agent’s career is built upon how willing they are to go above and beyond for their clients. Sometimes an agent goes too far and crosses the line into actions that put them in danger of a TREC complaint, or even a lawsuit by a disgruntled client. This is usually the result of being too focused on making the client happy at any cost or ensuring the transaction goes through after serious hiccups.
